reply_text:
One merge blocker:

* **[P1] Team and archive quotas become zero** — `src/plans.js:11`. JavaScript’s `<<` coerces values to signed 32-bit integers, so `entry.quotaKiB << 10` returns `0` for both plans. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty team account and an empty archive account. Use multiplication by `1024` instead, and add quota/upload tests for both plans.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they only exercise free-plan enforcement. Reviewed `3ebff74` against `main`; no code changed.
